title: Strength & conditioning coach
text: Coach group classes and small-group sessions. Cert III and IV in Fitness or equivalent, first aid and a love of explaining things.

title: Yoga & mobility instructor
text: Teach weekday morning and weekend classes to a friendly mixed crowd. At least 200 hours of training and a calm voice.

title: Front of house (early starts)
text: Open the doors at 5am, greet members and keep the club running. Weekday mornings, great coffee nearby.
